authority: Owner-authorized extension; supplied proposal is reference, not an implementation or deployment instruction
eligibilityContract: Read current evaluate(criteria) rows only. currentYolk = eligible === true AND demand === true AND qualifyingTier in [1,2,3] AND qualifyingTier <= maxDemandTier. Strategy selection cannot change Demand/Tier/eligible IDs.

counterContract.demandEligibleCount: All current Yolk rows before strategy view; reporting UUID unique
counterContract.opportunityViewCount: Eligible rows having at least one selected candidate_to_check strategy
counterContract.evidenceIncompleteCount: Eligible rows having no selected candidate and at least one evidence_incomplete assessment
counterContract.shortlistedCount: Saved targets; belongs to workspace storage, not engine
counterContract.scope: The caller filters administrative scope explicitly; never label a camera viewport count a national count

candidateMeaning: Survey cue, never confirmed gap, measured customer demand, market share, winning probability, parcel feasibility or permit

methods.strategies(): Bilingual metadata array; eight strategy IDs, summaries, icons, dataPhase, factor labels
methods.assess(row, criteria, context, profile,: Assessment root with assessments[], reasons[], evidenceRefs[], missingEvidence[], nextAction and observational sortTuple
methods.view(rows, criteria, context, profile, o: Counters and separate candidates / incomplete / notSupported / demandReview queues; rows aliases candidates
methods.selectedStrategyIds(profile, opts): Canonical unique strategy IDs; >3 and unknown ID reject

supplySemantics.scope: Use existing source-format or active company-license family filters. These are comparable source submarkets, not verified price/consumer segments or branch product availability.
supplySemantics.sameSubmarketRequirement: context.submarketComparable=false makes all supply-based queues evidence_incomplete
supplySemantics.countBounds: own=[ownLower,ownUpper+U], competitor=[competitorLower,competitorUpper+U]. Fallback lower/upper=count. total=[ownLower+competitorLower, ownUpper+competitorUpper+U]; U added once. Known nonbank bounds remain bounds.
supplySemantics.missing: Unknown U, invalid/negative/noninteger counts or ownScopeUnavailable never become zero
supplySemantics.relativeReference: count_equivalent_own = ownRateHigh * raw_positive_denominator / normalization_unit; competitor similarly
supplySemantics.thresholdCrossing: Supply interval crossing a low-supply cutoff = evidence_incomplete
supplySemantics.referenceLimit: Adjustable exploratory reference, not investment cutoff or measured capacity
supplySemantics.assignmentBoundsAvailability: boundsKnown === false means unavailable upper bounds, never exact zero; all supply strategies incomplete

complementaryP0.benchmark: Existing selected criteria cohort midrank; national default, same-grain explicit alternative. This is not an INC cutoff test and does not change Demand.
complementaryP0.limit: Area activity cue only. Current P0 has no hospital/school/anchor-coordinate proximity rule, no flow or purchases. Rooms are catalogue capacity; workers registry context.
complementaryP0.profileRelevance: Use at most3 factory_count/factory_workers/hotel_rooms metrics declared in profile.complementaryAnchors[].metricIds; population alone cannot support Complementary location. Empty supported activity set remains incomplete.

phases.P0: Existing CityMETER area metrics and scope-aware supply: candidate queues 1,3,5,7; transparent unsupported views for others; capped choice and evidence tasks
phases.P1: Structured offering/hour/customer occasion/anchor/site surveys; verified hospital/school POIs and spatial crosswalk; physical cluster evidence
phases.P2: Directed routing/access/daypart stop-buy studies; future milestone watchlist separate from current Yolks
phases.P3: Private brand sales/customer/capacity/cost data, network displacement and holdout calibration

acceptance: Demand/Tier/current eligible IDs unchanged under every strategy view
At most three unique strategies and three activity factors
Unresolved supply is not a measured absence
Within-source-scope comparisons preserve active format/license filters
Strategies 2/4/6/8 produce explicit data-incomplete states in P0
Future evidence never promotes a non-current area to Yolk
Evidence refs retain values/units/periods/source field/reporting UUID/scope
Each candidate has concrete missing evidence and first field task
No source/criteria/event mutation; deterministic order; no mixed-unit strategy sorting
